title: Thimsy emulator_config/card.json
description: A card's identity hints: every volume id each platform has seen for this card (OA-19, D20), who wrote the card last, the versions of shared emulators, and the BIOS copies Linux made. It is a hint, never a safety gate (linux_handheld_plan.md 7.7; LIBRARY-FORMAT.md 4.16). Thimsy-new file: this schema is what a writer of contract major 1 emits. Readers keep unknown fields and never refuse the file for them. No value is an absolute path, so Android's id-repair pass (emusync::repoint, which rewrites an id only when '/emulator_config' follows it) never edits it. Only the draft-07 keywords linux/tools/thimsy-import/thimsy_import/devicejson.py validates are used.

version.description: This file's own major version. Bumped only if a field changes meaning; adding fields never bumps it.

aliases.description: Every id this card has been seen under. A reader treats a path under /storage/<any listed id>/ found in this card's own files as a path on this card. One entry per id.

writers.description: Who last wrote the card, one entry per device model and platform (the foreign-card dialog's 'last used in').

emulators.description: The version of each shared emulator that last wrote its shared data, per platform, keyed by the emulator_config folder name (ppsspp, scummvm, retroarch).

copies.description: Files one platform copied for its own emulator from another emulator's folder (Flycast data/ BIOS into retroarch/system/dc/, DraStic BIOS into the melonDS DS names). Paths are relative to emulator_config/.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, informational only: handheld clocks are often wrong, so nothing orders by it.

anyOf.description: FAT or exFAT serial, upper case: the id Linux and stock Android use.
The Thimsy Android build's mount-order index (GammaOS Next vold).
ext4 UUID, lower case (not an interop card, listed for completeness).

platform.description: The platform that saw the card under this id.

source.description: self: the writer's own id for the card when it wrote; found: read from a /storage/<id>/ prefix in the card's own files (D20(b)).

device.description: multi_device_plan.md's descriptor id, the same on both builds for one model (anbernic-rg-arc-d).

contract.description: The LIBRARY-FORMAT.md major this writer implements.

relpath.description: Relative, forward slashes, no '.' or '..' parts, no token, no character FAT forbids.
